items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 122:1
items.html: (To the question) The separate Nukva is the HaVaYaH in the filling of Heys, whose Gematria is 52, as follows: Yud, Hey, Vav, Hey. And the four kinds of HaVaYaH act within her alone, in her nine Sefirot: the nine Sefirot of the face are in the straight, and the Malchuts of the face are their Gematria; and the nine Sefirot of the back are the four kinds of squares, as above; and their Gematria is the Malchuts of the back.
